answer: The nadir graph is validated at intake and the wharf frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and lantern anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Forging one identity takes 2 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 911 takes that multiplied out, plus 172 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
